blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives will hold a necrological service on Monday, Sept. 21, for the late Quirino Gov. Dakila Carlo “Dax” E. Cua, honoring him for a quarter-century of public service that took him from the provincial capitol to Congress and eventually to the leadership of local governments across the Asia-Pacific. The service will be held from 9 a.m. to noon at the House Plenary Hall, where Cua represented the lone district of Quirino from the 15th to the 17th Congresses from 2010 to 2019.
